description: Constructing the throttle policy with explicit interval and threshold settings for each of the three sources (global, ip, user) and reading them straight back. This confirms each configured value is stored on the source it names and is independently retrievable, establishing the tunable knobs the delay computation later consumes.

cases.expected_output:
global_interval=1
global_thresholds=2
ip_interval=3
ip_thresholds=4
user_interval=5
user_thresholds=6
